about: Transaction message templates per bank (core:ml TransactionParser). Each pattern is a case-insensitive Java regular expression; {amount}, {last4} and {merchant} mark the fields. The formats are approximations written for OpenCaller from the shape of common alerts, not copies of real messages: check them against real messages (docs/phase.md, Open issues). Senders are the registered header (India) or sender name (Bangladesh); US banks send from short codes, which are not listed here.
